name: Small-projection eager identical-callable negative control
registration: Before this null-control diagnostic; earlier eager fallback failures remain unchanged
purpose: Test whether the existing synchronized eager timing harness resolves a one-percent difference when every label invokes the exact same native Torch callable
accumulation: FP32; TF32 and reduced-precision BF16 reduction disabled
harness: Unchanged bench_dispatch._eager and summarize_dispatch; legacy prepared label is a null arm, not the actual prepared implementation
gate: Report original absolute A/A <=1% and paired 95% lower bound >=-1%; do not use this diagnostic to promote any implementation
settings: No power, CPU affinity, driver, clocks, voltage, kernel or source changes
telemetry: Read inventory and context before/after, no periodic GPU/driver queries during eager timings
reporting: Retain all raw samples, contexts, input and source hashes; failures diagnose measurement resolution and do not prove a particular noise source
